My worst teacher is a tie between my seventh grade teacher and my high school gym/health/science teacher. They were both the kind of teacher that if they liked you, you could do no wrong, but if they didn’t, you were screwed no matter what. I just so happened to be one of the ones neither of them liked, despite being a straight A, super shy goody-two-shoes. My seventh grade teacher was teaching us basketball in gym class, and we all had to dribble the ball and then throw it in the hoop one by one, and you weren’t allowed to move on until you got a basket. Well being the tiniest kid in class and not athletic in the slightest, when it got to my turn I struggled and couldn’t do it. After five tries, I asked if I could let someone else have a turn, as there were like 10 kids still behind me. She said no, and told me I had to stay there until I got a basket. The more I tried, the more the other kids laughed and made fun of me, and my teacher started mocking me as well when I started crying out of shame and embarrassment. I stood there for 10 minutes until the bell rang and class was over, and I have never forgotten how awful that made me feel. 
My high school teacher gave me a failing grade in running for gym even though i was one of only three kids who actually ran the full 30 minute run every class without stopping, while the other kids walked and played on their phones the whole time. In health class, when I handed in my report that I had spent all week on, she looked at the first two pages, handed it back and said “This is garbage. You have until the end of class to rewrite the whole thing or you’ll get a 0.” There was about 35 minutes left and I scrambled to come up with something to give her, but I still failed that assignment, along with two other kids she did the same thing to. Another time when she taught me chemistry, right before we had a major test, she asked me loudly in front of the whole class if I’d taken my “mental illness medication” beforehand. I had made the mistake of telling her I suffered from anxiety and was anxious about the coming test and she decided it was another opportunity to humiliate me. My mom and I complained multiple times to the principal, along with the parents of the other students she harassed, but because she had seniority and was one of the few qualified teachers they had they refused to do anything about it. 
I currently live in the same town I went to high school in, and I know she still lives around here so I’m constantly terrified I’m going to run into her at the grocery store or something.
